title: Wiki is unpublished: not in the footer or header
description:
**As a** visitor, **I want** the wiki omitted from site chrome until it has pages, **so that** we do not launch an empty encyclopedia.

Feature: Marketing wiki

  Scenario: The wiki is not linked from the footer
    Given the chattic.us home page
    Then the footer does not list a Wiki link
    And the News group does not list Wiki
